versions.content: Modeling of call-chain dependencies between BSW Mod- ules Type: valid Description: It SHALL be possible to describe which other API functions are invoked by a function. Rationale: Needed when the OS is configured since OS resources must be mapped to the tasks that utilize them. Dependencies: [RS_BSWMD_00046] Use Case: Derive which OS resources are used when a main function is invoked and this main function is invoking another API function, and so on. Supporting Material: 
